test_title: PYST 33: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

You have packed your warm clothes, ______?
solution:
The correct answer is **"haven't you?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is an example of a **question tag.**
 
• In a question tag sentence, the **main verb** in the sentence is used to make the ques
